_comment:
Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Updates (coverage_matrix.csv XLSX Tab 'Updates', 2.49 grab-bag section) > 'Prompted Update Scenario 2' - 'Forced CommCare update blocker'. This is the Updates(2.49)-tab's OWN Prompted Update Scenario 2, distinct from the Prompted Updates tab's 'Prompted Update Scenario 2' ('Forced CCZ update blocker screen' - an app-content/CCZ update, see hq_setup/prompted_updates/ for that one, handled separately). This row is about the CommCare BINARY (APK) forced-update blocker screen, so it toggles apk_prompt (not app_prompt) to 'forced' via HQ's update_prompts/<app_id>/ endpoint (PromptSettingsUpdateView). apk_version is left unset here (relies on hq_setup/updates_2_49/setup_02_commcare_version_plus_one.json having already run and pinned it) - run Setup 2 first, then this file, then the flow.

UPDATE (2026-08-24, 2nd correction), per a direct user-supplied screen recording of this exact test's real, working HQ configuration: app_prompt is 'on' there, not 'off' - corrected to match (the original 'off' was a defensive guess to avoid an app-level CCZ prompt confounding the on-device flow's assertions, but the real demonstrated setup runs with both prompts on simultaneously and still works, presumably because the forced CommCare-level blocker never lets the device reach a point where an app-level prompt would show anyway).

UPDATE (2026-08-24), per direct user-supplied app link (https://www.commcarehq.org/a/qateam/apps/view/8a04cdf1b9474ee2b090b1d7896b1bd7/) + screen recording: app_id switched to '[Master] Basic Tests NS Copy' (app_registry.py's BASIC_TESTS_NS_COPY entry), matching Setup 2's own switch.

UPDATE (3rd correction, same day): the real '2.63.1 ceiling' blocker Setup 2 needed past is now genuinely resolved - see hq_setup/updates_2_49/setup_02_commcare_version_plus_one.json's own header for the full citation (alpha/dev CommCare versions like '2.65.0/latest' are real, valid, HQ-known choices, just hidden from a regular user's own Manage Update Settings dropdown - confirmed live via a superuser session cookie; the regular automation account can still WRITE the value once its CSRF cookie is primed, no superuser needed for actual test runs). An earlier version of this UPDATE claimed '2.65.0/dev' was the fix - that was disproven live and is not the real value; Setup 2 now sets '2.65.0/latest' instead.

UPDATE (2026-08-24, per direct user instruction): Setup 2's own hardcoded '2.65.0/latest' has since been replaced with hq_client.py's dynamic DEV_APK_VALUE sentinel (see that file's own latest UPDATE) - this file's apk_version stays unset for the same reason as before (inherits whatever Setup 2 last resolved+pinned), no change needed here. Combined with prompted_update_scenario_01_ill_update_later.yaml as one logical 'Scenario 1 -> Scenario 2' progression (both/apk prompts on -> apk prompt forced, same target build throughout) - run Setup 2, then scenario_01's flow (asserts BOTH the optional prompt's Play-Store option and 'I'll update later' appear), then this file, then scenario_02's flow (asserts the forced blocker appears and 'I'll update later' is now gone), then hq_setup/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_teardown.json.

Run via `python scripts/hq_client.py hq_setup/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_02_forced.json` before flows/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_02_forced_commcare_update.yaml.
